text: December 2008. New York City. Snow was falling on Wall Street.
Investigators walked into a luxury apartment and arrested Bernard Madoff.
The seventy year old man ran Wall Street's biggest private fund.
For decades people trusted him with their life savings.
Banks trusted him. Charities trusted him. Even other crooks trusted him.
Then one day he told his sons a terrible secret.
His famous fund was fake. One giant Ponzi scheme.
New money kept flowing in to pay the old investors.
There was just one problem. The vault was empty.
Losses reached about sixty five billion dollars. The largest fraud in history.
Thousands of ordinary people lost everything they had.
In 2009 a judge gave him one hundred fifty years.
He never got out. He died behind bars in 2021.
So how did one man fool the world for forty years?
He looked safe. He looked boring. And that was the trick.
